pages.text: A ridden horse should feel responsive, not stubborn. Better Horses smooths out a long list of small frictions that vanilla horses used to throw at you.

pages.title: Step Up & Mine Through
pages.text: $(li)Step height is raised by 10% so a galloping horse no longer trips over slabs, paths, or full blocks at speed.$(li)Mounted block-breaking now matches on-foot speed for most blocks — mining from horseback is finally practical.$(li)The remaining penalty is cut by 80% to keep the feel light.

pages.title: Look Around Freely
pages.text: Mounting a horse no longer snaps your camera to its facing. The $(thing)horse rotates to match you$(), so the view stays still and natural.$(br2)While the horse is standing still, you get up to $(thing)90°$() of free look before the horse follows along — perfect for scanning the horizon at a hitchpost without dismounting.

pages.title: Out of Your Way
pages.text: Look down and the horse fades nearly invisible so it can't block your work or your aim.$(br2)While ridden, the horse's head also drops and tilts forward to clear your forward view — small touches that add up on long trips.

pages.title: Creative Convenience
pages.text: Using a $(item)Saddle$() (vanilla or upgraded) on a horse in $(thing)Creative Mode$() instantly tames the horse — no nibbling sugar cubes and waiting for hearts. Fast iteration when you're testing builds.
